newsitem.title: USA: California plastic surgeon shot to death.
newsitem.headline: California plastic surgeon shot to death.

text.p: A plastic surgeon was killed and his office manager critically wounded Thursday in a mysterious shooting at the doctor's office in a quiet northern California town, police said.
Police rushed to the office of Dr. Michael Tavis, 53, in Petaluma, 50 miles (80 km) north of San Francisco, after a member of the public reported hearing gunshots from inside his office.
Police found Tavis, 53, dead of a gunshot wound, Petaluma police spokesman Sgt. Mike Kerns said.
His office manager, Kay Carter, 59, had a gunshot wound to the head, Kerns said. Carter was rushed to Santa Rosa Memorial Hospital where she was reported in critical condition, Kerns said.
Kerns said the murder weapon had not been found. Police had no suspect and did not know the motive for the shootings, he said.
A police spokesman at the crime scene said however that police had "extensive leads" they would follow up on.
